messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: In the Mounjaro prescribing information, SURPASS-1 (NCT03954834) was a 40-week trial in adults with type 2 diabetes whose blood sugar was not adequately controlled with diet and exercise alone. Patients received once-weekly Mounjaro 5 mg, 10 mg, or 15 mg, or placebo.
After 40 weeks, 78% to 85% of adults taking Mounjaro achieved an HbA1c below 7%, compared with 23% of adults taking a placebo.
The average HbA1c change was -1.8% with Mounjaro 5 mg, -1.7% with Mounjaro 10 mg, and -1.7% with Mounjaro 15 mg, compared with -0.1% with placebo.
Triplet: ["SURPASS-1", "has treatment arms", "once-weekly Tirzepatide 5 mg"]

The relation 'has treatment arms' in the triplet is defined as 'The clinical trial includes the specified intervention or control group administered to participants.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'used in population': The subject drug is used in or approved for the patient population or age group specified by the object entity.
B. 'has onset of effect': The subject drug starts to work or shows its effect within the time period specified by the object entity.
C. 'has indication for initial dose': The subject drug's initial dose is indicated for the specified medical purpose or condition.
D. 'has recommended treatment for severe hypoglycemia': The subject drug is associated with the use of the specified medical intervention to manage severe hypoglycemia.
E. 'has recommended dose': The subject drug is typically prescribed at the dose or dosing regimen specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
